title: GraphKAN AMO NQS: Boundary Conditioned Pair Jastrow Benchmark and Reproducibility Release
description: GraphKAN AMO NQS is a reproducibility release for boundary conditioned pair Jastrow neural quantum state benchmarks in one dimensional Rydberg chains. The release contains the frozen ten site campaign, independent Linux replay, twelve site continuation, gauge and counterfactual analyses, source code, configurations, tests, checksums, and complete reviewer evidence. The results define an observable dependent and protocol dependent representation effect rather than general KAN or Graph KAN superiority.
